# SquachWatch-CYD v1.22.0 — Field-Tested CYDs

This release brings the work integrated and physically verified since v1.21.0 to the **classic 2.8-inch ST7789** and **3.2-inch ST7798 resistive** Cheap Yellow Displays. Those boards remain the primary hardware validation targets. Existing production board profiles and their optional 80 MHz display variants remain in the build matrix; unmerged experimental board PRs are not included.

## Highlights

- **Real GNSS support, UBX and NMEA.** Read an external GPS receiver on UART2 RX GPIO35 (115200 baud for the verified UBX module). Display fix, UTC, satellite counts and diagnostic details; derive **trusted UTC directly from a live GNSS fix** when Wi-Fi has not already supplied trusted time. GPS and status-icon visibility are independently configurable. Hardware verified on CYD, including the serial line `[gps] trusted UTC set from live GNSS fix`.
- **Stable 3.2-inch ST7798 screens.** Eliminated startup flashing, stale text from reusable sprite bands in Diagnostics, and BLE/Wi-Fi raw scan rows appearing beneath bottom buttons. Diagnostics pages scroll/page correctly; System Properties → Board stays open when an alert arrives. The 2.8-inch UI behavior remains intact.
- **SD reliability.** Improved card removal/reinsertion detection, mount/VFS recovery, file browser layout, hot-swap handling and FAT/VFS retention. SD icon provides visible state. Tested on physical CYD hardware.
- **Wi-Fi stability.** Resolved saved-network USE and WIFI BUSY failures on the 3.2-inch, connection/keyboard flicker, and buffered display recovery after update checks.
- **SquachMesh improvements.** Verified two-way 2.8-inch ↔ 3.2-inch message delivery, invites/acceptance, PASSIVE compatibility, message selection and in-range roster interaction.
- **WATCH / HUNT and alerts.** Improved long-press WATCH actions, timed Snooze and Unsnooze management, watch-alert navigation, clearer SquachMesh controls and alert rendering.
- **Squachy, gameplay and performance.** Expanded costumes and visual effects, fixed speech bubble rendering, and optimized aquarium graphics.
- **Detection and emulator regressions.** Refined exact Flock/Penguin signatures and Raven UUID matching; improved browser emulator version reporting and regression coverage.
- **Timestamped logs.** Use trusted UTC when writing SD detection records.

## Tested hardware and release safety

The classic **2.8-inch ST7789** and **3.2-inch ST7798** were manually tested for the GPS, display, SD, Wi-Fi and SquachMesh changes described above, with UBX GNSS at 115200 baud. The ESP32-C5, Freenove ESP32-S3, capacitive CYD32C/35C, CrowPanel and T-Watch GNSS experimental PRs are **not promoted** to production by this release. The optional 80 MHz TFT clock remains experimental.

This release retains SquachMesh BLE messaging and signed BLE OTA. Do not erase flash merely to upgrade: preserve existing device settings, SD data and saved mesh relationships unless recovery is actually required.

## Standard release checks

The `v1.22.0` tag must point to a commit whose `VERSION` is `1.22.0` and that includes these notes. GitHub Actions must compile the full published board matrix, verify signatures against the configured production signing key, generate merged recovery binaries and manifests, run its release validation, publish the GitHub Release and deploy the web flasher. Do not claim the release is published until those steps succeed.
